caption: The drawing depicts a single teapot positioned in profile, facing left. The teapot is rendered in shades of gray and black, suggesting a metallic surface with reflective qualities. The body of the teapot is rounded with a slightly flattened top, with a decorated horizontal band featuring an ornate leaf or floral pattern running around the widest part of the pot. The lid is domed with concentric layers and a dark, rounded knob at the top. The spout is long, slender, and curves outward from the left side of the teapot, tapering to a narrow tip. The handle is attached to the right side and has a bold, angular shape in dark black with some curved accents. The teapot sits on a short, ringed pedestal base with two small rounded feet visible at the front. The background is a plain, light beige or cream color, with no additional objects or details present in the composition. The artist's signature, "James J. O'Neill," is located to the lower right of the teapot.
title: Teapot
